color.note: One light theme. Navy leads, green supports, gold highlights. Brazil is implicit: never pair green and gold as a flag pattern.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen. Also the off-white disc behind the mascot, and light text/ outlines on navy hero blocks (10.5:1 on navy).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, form card, nav bar, inputs, tiles. Ink reads 15.5:1 here.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper off-white for quiet wells and dividers on paper. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and every outline: the 2px border on cards, inputs, chips, buttons and tiles; the default hard shadow. 14.5:1 on paper, 15.5:1 on surface, 7.8:1 on gold. The only text colour allowed on gold fills.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Muted body text: footnotes, chart labels, copy inside tinted panels. 8.4:1 on paper, 8.2:1 on gold-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, descriptions under titles, filter counts. 5.9:1 on paper, 6.3:1 on surface, ≥5.6:1 on every tint.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text only at 24px+ or for non-text marks: 3.6:1 on paper, 3.8:1 on surface — FAILS 4.5:1 for body-size text (kept as the brand defines it).

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text, on surface (4.6:1).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Hero blocks (with the dot grid), headlines on paper (10.5:1), primary buttons, the 'Capy' of the wordmark, the default card shadow.

tokens.name: navy-tint
tokens.usage: Tint behind navy text: topic tags, Certificações panel, nav-link hover, icon tiles. Navy reads 9.8:1, ink 13.5:1.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Headline and button text on navy fills (10.5:1). Alias of paper.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and breadcrumbs on navy hero blocks (8.8:1).

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Links, roles and subtitles on navy (8.3:1), e.g. the role line under the portfolio name. Never on light grounds.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Secondary brand colour: success, 'Folio' in the nav wordmark, eyebrows, text links and role lines on paper (4.55:1) or surface (4.9:1); fills for Eventos emblems and check marks with white on top (4.9:1). Do NOT set small green text on green-tint (4.35:1) — use green-ink.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Tint for success panels: Eventos group, results list, 'Com o CapyFolio' card, comment bubbles, 'Concluído' status.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Dark green text on green-tint (6.9:1) and surface (7.7:1): 'Pronto p/ Mercado', 'Destaque' labels.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Highlight and call to action. FILLS, borders, hard shadows and highlights only — never text on light grounds (1.9:1 on paper). Text on gold is ink (7.8:1). Active nav pill, CTA buttons, selected chips, the rotated sticker, Medalhas emblems, focus outline.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Warm tint: Medalhas group, featured sidebar, active-filter chips, 'Em andamento' status, like button, demo band.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber text on gold-tint (5.7:1) or surface (6.2:1), where a gold-coloured word is needed (e.g. the 'Pessimista' scenario).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside cards (card footers, dividers, 'ou' rule, chart gridlines) and the border of unselected skill chips on paper. Decorative only (1.3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger neutral line for dashed placeholders and timeline gaps.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Resting border of text inputs: 3.0:1 on surface; 2.8:1 on paper — below 3:1 there, kept as the brand defines it. Focus turns it navy.

tokens.name: dot-grid
tokens.usage: The 1.5px dots of the hero dot grid on navy, 26px pitch.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 3px solid, 3px offset. 5.6:1 on navy, but only 1.9:1 on paper and surface — under the 3:1 a focus ring needs on light grounds (kept from the source; flagged).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, heavy and tightly tracked. Headings, names, numbers, big buttons.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The student's name in the portfolio hero. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Login and landing hero headline, on navy.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Encontre estudantes pelo que já construíram
styles.usage: Page hero headline (Busca, Feed greeting at 76px). Balance the wrap.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Análise espacial da qualidade do ar
styles.usage: Project title in the project hero; prices.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section headings on long pages (Portfólio, Investidores), in navy.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page body; result counts (34px).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Values in stat tiles; key numbers go to 36px.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Names and titles inside cards and tiles (17–24px).

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Labels of 48–56px buttons, list-item titles, sticker text.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans for everything that is read rather than scanned.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Explore projetos, publique suas pesquisas e faça parte de uma comunidade que valoriza o conhecimento.
styles.usage: Hero sub-copy, post bodies and project summaries. Cap at 62–68ch.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small kicker above a page heading, in green.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Acesse com seu e-mail institucional ou crie uma nova conta.
styles.usage: Default body copy, comments, list items.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links and the nav's compact buttons (700).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, filter-group options, sort labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Ciência da Computação, Pesquisador IC, UFF
styles.usage: Metadata under names, links under forms.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, dt labels, tag text (700).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Achievement pills and chart labels. Smallest size in the product.

spacing.note: Mostly a 4px rhythm with the source's 10 and 14px steps kept. Page gutter 48px, max content width 1344px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Nav-link gap, tight stacks (name over role).

tokens.name: space-1_5
tokens.usage: Heading-to-subtitle gap; pill icon gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, label-to-input gap, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2_5
tokens.usage: Gap between tags and between logo and wordmark.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, list gaps, header element gap.

tokens.name: space-3_5
tokens.usage: Avatar-to-text gap, button row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of list items and inputs; avatar gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap inside sidebars; hero search padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (small cards), grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding (panels), gap from heading to section content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding (main content cards); column gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and content; form card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side gutter; hero inner gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top padding of page main; stat tiles overlap the hero by this much.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of hero blocks; investor-page tile overlap.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between big sections on the portfolio.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section spacing on the investor page; hero bottom padding.

radius.note: Mixed, chunky radii: 12–32px for blocks, full pills for chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, icon tiles, the sticker.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Standard buttons (48–56px tall).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: List items, feature rows, hero search, comment bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, project tiles, person avatars (square), scenario cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: post card, form card, filter sidebar, achievement groups.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Featured project card.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: Portfolio hero photo, demo band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, nav links, search pill, compact nav buttons.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round avatars, emblems, icon buttons, the mascot disc.

shadow.note: Hard offset only, never blurred. Colour the shadow by role: ink for neutral, navy for content, gold for highlight and primary actions, green for forms and success.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Selected filter chip, active scenario tab.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: List items, tiles in the featured sidebar, achievement rows.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Secondary and gold buttons at rest; project tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover lift of any button or tile: translate(-2px,-2px) plus this. Active presses in: translate(2px,2px), no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-primary-sm
tokens.usage: Compact navy buttons in the nav ('+ Publicar', 'Ver demo'), focused input.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Navy primary buttons ('Entrar', 'Ver portfólio'), login feature row.

tokens.name: shadow-on-navy
tokens.usage: Buttons that sit on a navy hero (paper-coloured shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Main content cards: post, project info, filter sidebar (6px).

tokens.name: shadow-card-gold
tokens.usage: Highlight panels and the mascot disc; gold sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-card-green
tokens.usage: The login form card; success panels (6px); featured project (10px).

tokens.name: shadow-photo
tokens.usage: The 280px student photo in the portfolio hero.

border.note: Every outline is solid ink; only inputs at rest use field-border.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Outline on cards, inputs, chips, buttons, tiles, the nav's bottom edge.

tokens.name: border-width-photo
tokens.usage: Hero photo and featured-cover icon tile.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width (colour: focus).

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between element and focus outline.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area: icon buttons, checkboxes rows, links in lists.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Filter chips and removable active-filter chips (target padded by row gap).

tokens.name: control-nav
tokens.usage: Nav search pill and nav buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Inline form buttons, card CTAs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs and page-header buttons.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Primary form submit, hero CTAs.

tokens.name: search-hero
tokens.usage: The search field in the Busca hero.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Post author avatar; achievement emblems.

tokens.name: avatar-lg

tokens.name: photo-hero
